subject.title: [regression] Bundled MCP config tempDir race still present on openclaw@2026.5.20 (#73244 reopened?)

question: How should Claude live-session artifact ownership be split after the retry-artifact fix: session-owned MCP config, run-owned retry artifacts, or regenerated artifacts for retries?
rationale: The current source conflict is between two real bug fixes: the original tempDir lifetime fix and the later recovery-retry artifact fix. A blind reapply or blind revert could break one of those paths.

options.title: Split ownership by artifact lifetime
options.body: Keep the persistent process's MCP config session-owned, keep retry-only artifacts run-owned or regenerate them before retry, and cover both paths with tests.

options.title: Keep run-owned artifacts
options.body: Accept the current retry-oriented model only after live proof shows persistent Claude sessions cannot respawn with stale `--mcp-config` paths.

options.title: Restore session ownership broadly
options.body: Reapply the older transfer shape and separately change fresh retries to rebuild artifacts before respawn.

recommendation.title: Split ownership by artifact lifetime
recommendation.body: Keep the persistent process's MCP config session-owned, keep retry-only artifacts run-owned or regenerate them before retry, and cover both paths with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored both the original Claude live-session feature and the current-main retry-artifact change that needs reconciliation.
